title: Product comparison across regions
description: Compare staple prices across the former provinces used as regions.

list.name: commodity
list.label: Commodity
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT commodity_group FROM dw.dim_commodity WHERE is_food ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average price by province, last 12 months of data

targets.rawSql:
SELECT province AS "Province", round(avg(avg_price_per_base_kes), 2) AS "KES per kg or litre"
FROM dw.v_price_trend
WHERE month >= (SELECT max(month) FROM dw.v_price_trend) - interval '12 months' AND price_type = '${price_type}' AND commodity_group = '${commodity}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT month AS time, province AS metric, round(avg(avg_price_per_base_kes), 2) AS value
FROM dw.v_price_trend
WHERE $__timeFilter(month) AND price_type = '${price_type}' AND commodity_group = '${commodity}'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Staples by province: average KES per kg or litre, last 12 months of data
panels.description: Empty cells mean no market in that province reported the commodity in the window. Western province has no markets in the WFP source.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT commodity_group AS "Commodity",
       round(avg(avg_price_per_base_kes) FILTER (WHERE province = 'Central'), 0) AS "Central",
       round(avg(avg_price_per_base_kes) FILTER (WHERE province = 'Coast'), 0) AS "Coast",
       round(avg(avg_price_per_base_kes) FILTER (WHERE province = 'Eastern'), 0) AS "Eastern",
       round(avg(avg_price_per_base_kes) FILTER (WHERE province = 'Nairobi'), 0) AS "Nairobi",
       round(avg(avg_price_per_base_kes) FILTER (WHERE province = 'North Eastern'), 0) AS "North Eastern",
       round(avg(avg_price_per_base_kes) FILTER (WHERE province = 'Nyanza'), 0) AS "Nyanza",
       round(avg(avg_price_per_base_kes) FILTER (WHERE province = 'Rift Valley'), 0) AS "Rift Valley",
       round(avg(avg_price_per_base_kes) FILTER (WHERE province = 'Western'), 0) AS "Western"
FROM dw.v_price_trend
WHERE month >= (SELECT max(month) FROM dw.v_price_trend) - interval '12 months' AND price_type = '${price_type}'
  AND commodity_group IN (SELECT DISTINCT commodity_group FROM dw.dim_commodity WHERE is_staple)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
